c.tagline: Bold modern architecture and Europe's biggest port.

taxi.fareNote: Metered; official taxis carry a blue licence plate. Booking apps are common.

emergency.note: 112 is the single EU emergency number for police, ambulance and fire in the Netherlands.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

avoid.reason: No real no-go zones; a few pockets of Rotterdam-Zuid feel edgy late at night but hold nothing for tourists.
Pickpockets work Centraal station, busy trams and markets; lock your bike well, as bike theft is rife.

hood_desc: The rebuilt modern heart of the city around the Markthal, Cube Houses, Lijnbaan shopping street and Rotterdam Centraal; the most convenient, walkable base for first-timers.

A futuristic waterfront quarter on the south bank at the foot of the Erasmus Bridge, home to landmark towers, Hotel New York and cruise terminals; suits travelers who want skyline views and design hotels.
A former docklands peninsula turned foodie hotspot, with the Fenix Food Factory, theatres and buzzing restaurants; good for those chasing dining and a lively, local scene.
A rare surviving historic harbor of 17th-century canals, the Pilgrim Fathers' church and craft breweries; a calmer, characterful area a short metro ride west of the centre.
The arts-and-nightlife strip around Witte de Withstraat and the Museumpark galleries, packed with bars, cafes and street art; best for creative, going-out travelers.

water.note: Tap water is excellent and safe everywhere in the Netherlands.

transit.hours: Metro and trams run roughly 6am-midnight; BOB night buses cover the city into the small hours on Friday and Saturday nights.
transit.pay: Tap a contactless debit/credit card or phone directly on metro gates, trams and buses via OVpay — no card purchase needed — or buy a rechargeable OV-chipkaart. Fares are distance-based (roughly €1-4 / US$1-4.30 per trip); a RET 2-hour ticket from the driver is about €4.50 (~US$4.90).

air: Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS) — ~40 min by direct intercity train

transit.m: Bus 33 to Meijersplein + Metro E to the centre

tip.r: ~5–10% for good service; rounding up is common
